periods.time: Morning in Fukuoka at the blizzard's eye
periods.type: boss battle / diversion and assassination attempt
periods.location: Fukuoka ruins, eye of Tendo's storm
periods.summary: Moroboshi and Kuraudo enter the eye of Daien's blizzard as the first and second arrows. Moroboshi enchants Kuraudo's Orochimaru with Tiger Bite, forming Gluttonous Serpent, so Kuraudo's attacks can harm Tendo's magic body. Kuraudo tears through Tendo's tornado, lightning, heat, and debris using Akuro-o and repeatedly shaves down the giant Ame-no-Murakumo until it breaks. His exhausted attack fails to finish Tendo, but it fixes Tendo's attention long enough for Moroboshi to pierce him with Musou Ittetsu and destroy his soul.
periods.cause: The Kyushu grid operation needs time and Tendo's attention diverted; Moroboshi also believes Kuraudo can bridge the gap he cannot cross alone.
periods.process: Kuraudo uses Tiger Bite-coated blades despite his Device being eaten, chases Tendo through Black Dragon and lightning, wounds him, and blocks the enormous falling sword. Moroboshi stays within range to maintain the enchant, then strikes Tendo's soul from behind at the moment Tendo focuses on Kuraudo.
periods.outcome: Tendo's living body dies and his soul is consumed, but his will persists as a storm-bound remnant that summons twelve Ame-no-Murakumo swords. Moroboshi refuses to play Tendo's Awakening trial and points to Toka as the third arrow.
periods.significance: Removes Tendo's physical/soul body, proves Moroboshi's and Kuraudo's roles, and sets up Toka's final ideological victory.
